title: I built a fully open-source RC flight simulator focused on hyper-realistic physics (alpha), please roast it!
author: bultodepapas
selftext:
**Please roast it.** I genuinely want all the criticism: what feels wrong, what’s missing, what you actually want and need in a sim. That’s how this gets better.

I’m an engineer, and I’ve spent a long time working on pure physics. I wanted an RC sim that’s built on real physics first, so I made one. It’s **100% open source and will always be free.** Copy it, fork it, break it.

**What it has right now:**

* Hyper-realistic flight physics: real flying, real landings, real feel
* Wind, turbulence, weather, and time of day
* Night flying with LEDs
* Realistic materials and damage: props break, landing gear flexes, ground and grass friction
* Planes (including jets, the classic Ugly Stick for learning, and the Timber), helicopters (some still in testing), and RC cars
* A tornado scenario
* Crash cost calculator (still in testing)
* Works with an Xbox controller, your EdgeTX radio, sim USB dongles, or basically any joystick

**What’s coming:**

* More physics realism and better per-model flight feel
* Next plane: the Sonicmodell Skyhunter
* INAV integration
* FPV racing drones
* Boats and water physics
* Better crash cost calculator
* New scenarios

**Heads up:** this is a very early alpha. Because of how deep the physics goes, there’s still a lot of polishing to do. New versions drop almost daily, so please keep updated to the latest one.

Big thanks to **Sonicmodell, Hitec, and Savox** for their support, and to **OpenAI** (Codex) for backing open-source projects like this. We’re also working toward licensed models from well-known brands.I also saw other sim which is an excellent sim. If you’re the dev, you’re more than welcome to join this project and bring your ideas and criticism.
